result.false_positives: None of the 15 findings in tools/lint_bank.out.txt is a false positive. Every one is a real \"1 <plural>\" that a student sees. Scanning seeds 0-299, with options included, turned up these latent false-positive patterns, which the lint will hit once options are scanned or more seeds are run. (1) The 1 is the last term of an expression, so the plural is correct: rtt.cofunction_angles \"the measure of angle N is x + 1 degrees\" (seeds 134, 178, 184). (2) The 1 is the subject of a verb missing from PLURAL_EXCEPTIONS: circles.equation_read \"= 1 defines a circle\" (170), nleq.radical_equation \"only x = −1 satisfies\" (218, 222), ovd.freq_choose \"1 appears 3 times\" (249). (3) The multiplier \"1 times as great\" (nlfunc.interpret_value options), which is acceptable math English. The existing exceptions already absorb hundreds of \"1 is / 1 as / 1 costs / 1 gives\" hits. The lint also has false NEGATIVES. It skips options, so it missed the flawed KEY of nlfunc.interpret_value (seed 16) and only caught quad_feature and mix_statement through their rationales and reasons. Its \\w*s pattern skips irregular plurals, so it missed lat.shadow \"1 feet long\" at seeds 3, 22, 36, 37 and 47. And range(50) hides eight more flawed templates that first appear past seed 49.
result.lint_fix:
tools/lint_bank.py, three edits.
(1) Line 37:
PLURAL = re.compile(r\"(?<![\\d.−-])(?<![+−-]\\s)\\b1\\s+([a-z][a-z-]*s|feet|people|children|men|women)\\b\", re.I)
The added lookbehinds skip a 1 that is negative (\"−1 degrees\") or the last term of a sum or difference (\"x + 1 degrees\"). \"= 1 inches\" and \"× 2 = 1 units\" still match. The alternation adds the irregular plurals.
(2) PLURAL_EXCEPTIONS: add \"appears\", \"defines\", \"satisfies\", \"times\".
(3) In scan(), after the grid-in line: grammar_parts.extend((f\"option {i + 1}\", o) for i, o in enumerate(item.choices)). Leave table rows out: joining cells with spaces can create false \"1 <word>s\" pairs, and the scan found no table hits.
Verified from a scratch copy (repo untouched). At seeds 0-49 the tightened check keeps all 15 current findings and adds lat.shadow (3, 22, 36, 37, 47) and nlfunc.interpret_value (16), with 0 false positives. At seeds 0-299 it reports 20 templates, all real, with 0 false positives; every false positive above is gone. Optional: range(50) -> range(300) in main() for this check, which surfaces circles.arc, circles.arc_pair, ineq.model_one_var, le2.graph_combinations, lin1.context_solve, nlfunc.quad_fit, rr.dimension_shift and the hours scene of sstat.interpret_mean.
